summary: Gorax presents a top-performing Ice Blast team composition for the Season 8 boss Mekkatorque in Dragonheir: Silent Gods. The team relies on Beldelle as the main DPS, supported by Ernesto, Fredegonda, Shinnah, and Anselmo. This setup deals over 600 million damage at Inspiration 0 and scales up to 1.78 billion damage with higher Inspirations. The video details stat priorities, itemization, spatial positioning, skill timing setups, and budget hero substitutes like Felosia and Feenja.

heroes.name: Beldelle
heroes.note: Stack as much Attack and Crit Rate as possible; Crit Damage can be skipped unless positive runes have exceptional offensive sub-stats.

heroes.name: Shinnah
heroes.note: Applies Witches Remain and requires high Accuracy; ensure her Attack stat remains lower than Beldelle's.

heroes.name: Ernesto
heroes.note: Buffs Beldelle and grants team shields to ensure survival; prioritize Skill Haste, Attack, and defensive stats.

heroes.name: Fredegonda
heroes.note: Build with high Crit Rate and Crit Damage; her passive buffs the Ice Blast ally placed directly in front of her.

heroes.name: Anselmo
heroes.note: Requires high Skill Haste, Accuracy, and Defense; equipped with Conflagration of Bones set to inflict additional Bleed debuffs.

heroes.name: Felosia
heroes.note: Can directly replace Anselmo in the Ice Blast rotation if Anselmo is not available.

heroes.name: Feenja
heroes.note: Can be slotted into the team when building for high Resistance strategy against boss mechanics.

teams.note: Top single-target Ice Blast team achieving up to 1.78B damage with high Inspiration and over 600M at Inspiration 0. Position Beldelle in front of Fredegonda.

meta_changes: Single-target Ice Blast teams are top-tier damage competitors against Season 8 Mekkatorque boss, proving viable even at zero Inspiration.
tips: Always position Beldelle directly in front of Fredegonda so Fredegonda's passive ice crystal buffs apply to Beldelle.
Keep Shinnah's total Attack lower than Beldelle's so attack buffs go to the correct main carry.
Set ultimate timing to Fredegonda at 12.0s, Beldelle at 12.2s, and Shinnah at 16.0s, leaving Ernesto and Anselmo on Default.
If missing Anselmo, replace him with Felosia and move Fredegonda forward in the formation.
title: Best Ice Blast Team vs Mekkatorque | Rasp of Gears S8 | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
